College and Career Youth Summit 
The Eighth Grade College and Career Awareness Summit 
serves as a follow-up to the College Positive Campus 
Tours, emphasizing the importance of higher education 
for area youth. On May 7th and 8th, we welcomed a total 
of 1,871 eighth grade students from 9 schools within Fall 
River and New Bedford. 
Keynote speaker Carlos Ojeda Jr., CEO of CoolSpeak: The 
Youth Engagement Company, is a youth development 
expert, with over fifteen years of experience inspiring 
students and professionals worldwide. Carlos inspired 
attendees with a powerful message about leading with 
love, fighting for a better future, and staying focused 
despite life's obstacles. 
Students also left the summit with a stronger 
understanding of the importance of education. 82% 
agreed that their high school grades are important for 
getting into college, while 69% recognized that education 
beyond high school is important to their future. 
Feedback from the teachers and chaperones further 
reinforced the summit's impact. 81% agreed that 
the keynote speaker positively influenced students' 
aspirations to attend college, while 74% believed the 
summit increased students' knowledge about college. 
Teachers described the event as "powerfully moving," 
"energizing," and "motivational and uplifting," praising 
the speaker's ability to connect with middle school 
students and inspire them to believe in their potential. 
The surveys also identified an important opportunity for 
continued outreach. Only 31% of students believe they 
will be able to afford to attend a college or university 
after high school. This finding underscores the need to 
strengthen future programming on college affordability, 
financial aid, scholarships, and grants. By continuing to 
address these barriers while encouraging students to set 
goals and prepare for success, the Youth Summit remains 
an important step in helping local students envision a 
future that includes higher education.
